entries.name: MCbiF wave-indexed employment-state cluster consistency — full null battery
entries.objective: Run the full MCbiF bifiltration + wave-label-permutation null battery (B=1000) on the frozen 27,280-trajectory PCA-20 BHPS/USoc embedding, using employment-state categorical partitions at each wave position. Determine whether H1 rank exceeds the 95th percentile of the permutation null (FDR-corrected, BH). Baselines: ARI-across-waves, conditional entropy, consensus clustering. Decision: ADDITIVE / REDUNDANT / INFEASIBLE (maps to prose direction per outcome-to-prose locked below).

metric_space.data: Frozen 27,280-trajectory PCA-20 embedding (BHPS + USoc); sequences at 01_trajectories_sequences.json
metric_space.partition_method: categorical: at each wave position w, partition[i] = employment_state[i][w]; 9 categories (EH,EL,EM,IH,IL,IM,UH,UL,UM); k fixed at 9 — no k-means
metric_space.wave_coverage: all valid wave positions across BHPS (waves 1-18) and USoc continuation; record n_valid per position

frozen_files.constraint: SHA-256 of both files recorded at run time; no re-embedding permitted

null_model.operation: wave-label permutation — randomly permute the wave-index ordering in the partition sequence before MCbiF bifiltration construction; each draw builds a fresh bifiltration from the shuffled sequence
null_model.invariance_requirement: permutation MUST be applied to wave ordering before bifiltration construction; post-construction permutation is degenerate and invalidates the null
null_model.parallel_workers: >=4 (loky backend — gudhi GIL constraint: do NOT use threading backend)

baselines: ARI-across-waves: pairwise partition agreement between all wave-position pairs
Conditional entropy of wave-to-wave employment-state transitions
Consensus clustering matrix: mean cluster co-assignment across all wave positions
entries.scale_caution: At full scale (27,280 trajectories × ~30 wave positions), the MCbiF bifiltration may be substantially larger than the spike (500 × 5 → 3.8M simplices). Worker must run a pre-flight cost estimate (time one bifiltration build at full scale) before launching B=1000 draws. If wall-time exceeds 8h projection, surface to Manager with a down-scoped alternative (e.g. BHPS-only waves 1-10, ~18,000 trajectories).

decision_rule.additive: H1 rank (observed) > 95th percentile of B=1000 wave-label-permutation null (FDR-corrected, Benjamini-Hochberg) AND H1 signal not reproduced by ARI-across-waves or conditional entropy at same significance level -> Outcome A: ADDITIVE; write [RESULT] vault entry; proceed to prose per outcome_to_prose.additive.
decision_rule.redundant: H1 rank non-trivial but fully explained by ARI-across-waves at matched significance -> Outcome B: REDUNDANT; write [RESULT] vault entry; update backlog to parked; no prose.
decision_rule.infeasible: H1 rank falls within null distribution at all tested wave configurations -> Outcome C: INFEASIBLE; write [NEGATIVE] vault note; update backlog to killed; no prose.

outcome_to_prose.additive: MCbiF wave-indexed employment-state cluster conflicts are a new methodological contribution to trajectory analysis. Target: Track C paper (trajectory_tda extension). Section: results/methodology contribution. Claim: MCbiF H1 detects three-way employment-state group conflicts not captured by pairwise metrics (ARI, conditional entropy). No prose drafted until this task emits ADDITIVE.
outcome_to_prose.redundant: No prose. Update backlog to parked with reason 'H1 redundant with ARI-across-waves'. Computational-Log [RESULT] entry only.
outcome_to_prose.infeasible: No prose. Write [NEGATIVE] note at vault/00-Meta/Discovery/mcbif-employment-clustering-spike-negative.md. Update backlog to killed.
